items.definition:
free from bacteria; unable to produce offspring; lacking interest
The surgical instruments must be kept sterile.

not based on or behaving according to what is morally right and fair
The decision felt completely unjust.

obedient; in accordance with rules
The company aims to be fully compliant with environmental regulations.

opposite or contrary in position, direction, order, or effect
There is an inverse relationship between price and demand.

consisting of various kinds; mixed
The box contained a miscellaneous collection of old toys.

relating to the period before written records
Dinosaurs lived in prehistoric times.

not based on or conforming to what is generally done or believed
His unconventional approach to problem-solving often yielded surprising results.

able to move quickly and easily
The agile gymnast performed a perfect routine.

rough or loose in texture or grain; (of a person or their speech) rude, crude, or vulgar
The fabric felt coarse against her skin.

relating to the heart, especially the coronary arteries
He suffered a coronary thrombosis.

inactive or asleep
The volcano has been dormant for centuries.

overwhelmed by sorrow or grief
She was heartbroken when her pet dog died.

tentative, unsure, or slow in acting or speaking
He was hesitant to accept the new job offer.

showing a clear understanding of a complex situation
Her insightful comments helped us understand the problem better.

horrifyingly wicked; enormous
The company was accused of monstrous greed.

good at persuading someone to do or believe something
She made a very persuasive argument for her proposal.

having a large population
China is the most populous country in the world.

after a war
The country experienced rapid economic growth in the postwar period.

creating or controlling a situation rather than just responding to it
She took a proactive approach to her career, seeking out new opportunities.

acting with or showing care and thought for the future
It was a prudent decision to save money for retirement.

dependent on someone or something
Many small businesses are reliant on government support.

having a good reputation
Always choose a reputable company for home repairs.

formal and dignified; serious
The atmosphere in the church was very solemn.

not yet published
She has several unpublished novels in her drawer.

able to be trusted as being accurate or true; commanding and self-confident
She spoke in an authoritative tone, leaving no room for doubt.

too poor to produce much or any vegetation; bleak and lifeless
The barren landscape stretched for miles under the scorching sun.

relating to a bureaucracy or bureaucrat; excessively complicated administrative procedure
The process was slow and bureaucratic, requiring many forms.

starting with the earliest and following the order in which they occurred
Please list the events in chronological order.

intimidating, challenging
The task seemed daunting at first, but we managed to complete it.

lacking restraint in spending money or using resources
They lived an extravagant lifestyle, spending money without much thought.

deeply felt; sincere
He offered a heartfelt apology for his mistake.

suggesting that something bad is going to happen
The dark clouds looked ominous, signaling a coming storm.

relating to the Pope or the papacy
The papal visit attracted millions of pilgrims.

suitable or enjoyable for playing
The new video game demo is finally playable.

elegant or stylishly luxurious
They stayed in a very posh hotel in the city center.

clever in a dishonest or deceptive way
He gave a sly wink to his accomplice.

conceited or arrogant, especially in a bold or impudent way
His cocky attitude often gets him into trouble.

made in exact imitation of something valuable or important with the intention to deceive or defraud
The police seized a large number of counterfeit banknotes.

tense, nervous, or irritable; avant-garde or trend-setting
The new band has an edgy sound that appeals to a younger audience.

Strange or unusual in a disturbing way.
The movie had some really freaky special effects.

Elegant and smooth in movement or form.
The ballerina performed a graceful pirouette.

Containing or covered with grit; showing courage and resolve.
The film offered a gritty portrayal of urban life.

Sexually attracted to people of the opposite sex.
The survey included participants of various sexual orientations, including heterosexual individuals.

relating to or constituting several cultural or ethnic groups within a society
London is a very multicultural city.

required by a rule or law; compulsory
Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists.

relating to the ocean
The oceanic currents influence global weather patterns.

preying naturally on others
Lions are predatory animals.

revived or regenerated
After the crisis, the city felt reborn.

having a regular, repeated pattern of sound or movement
The dancer moved with rhythmic grace.

feeling no shame; impudent
His shameless behavior shocked everyone.

shaped like a sphere or ball
The Earth is approximately spherical.

causing difficulty or annoyance
The troublesome child refused to go to bed.

sudden and unexpected
The car came to an abrupt stop.

relating to the story of someone's life
The film was a biographical drama about a famous artist.

of or relating to comedy; humorous
His comedic timing was perfect, making everyone laugh.

relating to or indicating direction
The new antenna provides better directional signal reception.

tending to be different or develop in different directions
They had divergent opinions on the best course of action.

basic; fundamental
Water is an elemental force of nature.

covering a wide area; extensive
The desert stretched out in an expansive landscape.

wholesome and substantial; enthusiastic
We enjoyed a hearty breakfast before our hike.

treating all rivals or disputants equally; fair and unbiased
A judge must remain impartial during a trial.

extremely unpleasant or offensive
His obnoxious behavior made everyone uncomfortable.

legally or morally entitled to something
She claimed her rightful place as the heir.

sticky; able to stick
This tape is very adhesive.
